gen-gf-paprika-gf-mukta: Commanding and expressive, Paprika spreads its letters wide and lets the lowercase fill the line like capitals. And Mukta answers with tall-bodied small letters that stay clean and quiet underneath.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-mukta-mahee: Mukta Mahee reads as chunky and approachable, its tall lowercase letters sitting solid on the line in plain sans fashion. Mukta Mahee would carry paragraph after paragraph without fuss, while Paprika makes all the noise above it.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-mukta-malar: Paprika's lowercase swells to fill the line like capitals, with counters that breathe wide open. But Mukta Malar, with its compressed ascenders, is the one built to sit quietly and carry the text.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-mukta-vaani: Mukta Vaani reads as contemporary and unfussy, with a high-waisted lowercase that keeps lines tidy. Paprika brings the loud, scattered display shapes above, and the two split the work between shouting and explaining.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-narnoor: Narnoor reads in a businesslike way, with short ascenders sitting above big, generous bowls on every line. Give it a modest size and let Paprika handle the volume.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-display: Paprika is commanding and expressive, its wide-set letters hard to ignore. Noto Sans Display answers with a big, tall middle zone in every word, so a modest size is enough for it.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-play: Paprika's lowercase swells until it fills the line like capitals, giving the heading real presence. And Play settles in beneath it as a plain sans, with sturdy bowls and barely any height step between cases.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-port-lligat-sans: Paprika spreads its letters at a distance, with counters that breathe like a hollow reed cut open. Port Lligat Sans tucks its characters in tight as pins in a cushion, so the two feel like open air against a crowd.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-ramabhadra: Loud up top, tidy below, with a heading that fills the line and a body built on a prominent x-height. Ramabhadra is the sober half, and Paprika is the showy one.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-rambla: Big, brash letters over a quiet text, with Paprika's lowercase swelling to fill each line like capitals. Rambla keeps its small letters nearly as tall as capitals, so reading feels steady.
